publications.authors: Müller, A, Wouters, E F, Koul, P, Welte, T, Harrabi, I, Rashid, A, Loh, L C, Al Ghobain, M, Elsony, A, Ahmed, R, Potts, J, Mortimer, K, Rodrigues, F, Paraguas, S N, Juvekar, S, Agarwal, D, Obaseki, D, Gislason, T, Seemungal, T, Nafees, A A, Jenkins, C, Dias, H B, Franssen, F M E, Studnicka, M, Janson, C, Cherkaski, H H, El Biaze, M, Mahesh, P A, Cardoso, J, Burney, P, Hartl, S, Janssen, D J A, Amaral, A F S
publications.abstract: Dyspnoea is a common symptom of respiratory disease. However, data on its prevalence in general populations and its association with lung function are limited and are mainly from high-income countries. The aims of this study were to estimate the prevalence of dyspnoea across several world regions, and to investigate the association of dyspnoea with lung function.
